featured_reviews.name: Khozema Manasawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to share my deepest appreciation for the exemplary service, professionalism, and profound empathy demonstrated by the team at your Clare Road branch in Mumbai—specifically Branch Manager Mr. Pramod, my Relationship Manager Mr. Faisal, and Ms. Minal Parab.

Losing my mother earlier this year was an incredibly difficult emotional experience, and being based in Singapore, I was completely clueless and overwhelmed about how to handle the closure of my Mother's resident savings bank account from abroad.

From my very first remote interaction, Mr. Pramod and Mr. Faisal completely eased my anxieties. They guided me step-by-step while I was still in Singapore, reassuring me that they would manage the logistics and ensure all proceeds were seamlessly transferred to my NRO account. True to their word, they promised to handle everything the moment I arrived in Mumbai this June.

When I walked into the Clare Road branch, the team’s warmth was palpable. They genuinely understood the grief I was going through and treated me with the utmost dignity and respect. What I expected to be a tedious, stressful process was handled with absolute precision; Faisal and Minal had everything prepared, and I was out of the bank in just 20 minutes with all formalities successfully completed.

In a world where banking is increasingly transactional, Mr. Pramod, Faisal, and Minal redefined what true customer care looks like. They combined seamless professional efficiency with genuine human compassion.

Please convey my sincere gratitude to the Clare Road team. They are a stellar asset to DCB Bank, and because of them, my trust in your institution is higher than ever.

Warm regards,

Khozem
